{{Top|leg}}
'''Huffee Vindaag''' was a thug who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Vindaag received a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] from a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] dispatched by [[Arrek Von Sarko]] in [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Huffee Vindaag]]
Folux Pozur was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
